Overview

Description: In 2024, online shopping in Sweden was estimated at around 140 billion Swedish kronor, up from 133 billion in 2023. The COVID-19 epidemic led to a significant increase in online commerce in Sweden, from 87 billion Swedish kronor in 2019 to 146 billion
in 2021. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; 2004 to 2024
Source(s): HUI Research; Kantar; PostNord; Svensk Digital Handel

Description: From 2007 to 2021, the e-commerce share of the total retail market in Sweden steadily increased. Online retail accounted for 15 percent of total retail in 2022, down one percentage point from 2021. This marks the first time e-commerce has decreased in
the country. Since consumers returned to physical stores after the COVID-19 pandemic, e-commerce suffered losses. In 2024, the online share of the total retail market decreased to 12 percent. Read more
Note(s): Sweden; 2007 to 2024
Source(s): HUI Research; PostNord; Svensk Digital Handel

Description: The most common online purchase frequency in Sweden is once a month, according to a 2024 study. Nearly four out of ten shoppers bought items online monthly. A fifth of Swedish shoppers reported doing online shopping once per week, making it the
second most popular purchase frequency. Only seven percent of those surveyed reported that they make several purchases per week of products online. Read more
